[ASSISTANT_SAID] Appendix A: A Better Way to Mourn: The MOURN Process  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The MOURN process offers a framework to guide us through grief while honoring our loved ones and allowing ourselves to heal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] M: Miss Them - Acknowledge and honor the absence of loved ones.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for M: Set aside time to grieve intentionally, share stories and memories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] O: Own Your Feelings - Embrace emotions without judgment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for O: Practice self-compassion, seek professional support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] U: Understand the Process - Educate yourself about grief.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for U: Read books and articles about grief, attend grief support groups.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] R: Remember the Good Times - Honor the memory of loved ones by recalling happy moments.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for R: Create a memory box or album, share positive memories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] N: New Memories (in Memory) - Create new experiences while honoring loved ones.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for N: Establish new traditions, find ways to give back.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The MOURN process is not linear; embrace each stage as it comes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By utilizing the MOURN process, you can find hope and healing in the midst of loss.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Appendix B: Scriptures for Comfort and Healing  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Selected Bible verses to offer solace and encouragement during grief.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Psalm 34:18 (NIV) - "The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Isaiah 41:10 (NIV) - "So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God..."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Matthew 5:4 (NIV) - "Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2 Corinthians 1:3-4 (NIV) - "Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord
